seoTitle: JSON to TOON Converter: Fewer Tokens for LLM Prompts
metaDescription: Convert JSON to TOON (Token-Oriented Object Notation), the compact indentation format with tabular arrays, and see the estimated token saving.
intro: Shrink structured data for LLM prompts by writing arrays of uniform objects as tables instead of repeating every key.
why:
TOON writes objects with indentation, primitive arrays inline (tags[2]: a,b) and arrays of uniform objects as a header plus one row per item (users[2]{id,name}:). Strings are quoted only when needed. The output of this tool follows the core of the published spec and decodes with the reference @toon-format/toon library; tested by round-tripping thousands of random values in both directions.

This implementation writes the standard forms and does not use the newer nested-column or keyed-table extensions. Savings are largest for long lists of similar records; deeply nested or irregular data saves little. Token counts shown are 4-characters-per-token estimates.

No data is sent anywhere: the work happens in your browser, so you can use it offline once the page has loaded.
howTo: Choose indentation and array delimiter (comma, tab or pipe).
Copy the TOON and read the character and token savings.
Tell the model the format in your prompt, or include one example.
